grading_key.VERIFIED: stated in a primary source read directly, quoted

sources.title: OpenAI Image generation guide
load_bearing: No negative_prompt parameter exists in the API.
Masking with GPT Image is entirely prompt-based. The model uses the mask as guidance, but may not follow its exact shape with complete precision.
mask must contain an alpha channel; applied to the first image

sources.title: OpenAI imagegen skill (vendored)
load_bearing: For edits, say 'change only X; keep Y unchanged' and repeat invariants on every iteration to reduce drift.
Label each image by index and role (Image 1: edit target, Image 2: style reference).
gpt-image-2 always uses high fidelity for image inputs, so do not set input_fidelity.
Masking is prompt-guided; exact shapes are not guaranteed.
quality, input_fidelity, explicit masks, background, output_format are fallback-only execution controls; not built-in image_gen arguments.
Include intended use to set the level of polish.
Core params list contains no seed parameter.
Game-asset recipe Constraints lines are IP-hygiene only ('no logos or trademarks; no watermark').

sources.title: Characterizing Photorealism and Artifacts in Diffusion Model-Generated Images (CHI 2025)
load_bearing: Five-category artifact taxonomy: anatomical / stylistic / functional implausibilities, violations of physics, sociocultural implausibilities
599 images (149 real, 450 AI); 50,444 participants; 749,828 observations
Prevalence: functional 58.7%, anatomical 51.4%, stylistic 39.0%, physics 9.17%, sociocultural 5.50%
Detection accuracy (>80% excluded): functional 64.1%, anatomical 65%, stylistic 64.9%
Comment mentions: anatomical 61%, stylistic 30%, functional 21%, physics 15%, sociocultural 4%
Overall 76% on AI / 74% on real; 72% at 1s vs 82% at 20s
GAP: exclusively photorealistic outputs; no stylized/illustrated coverage

sources.title: Diablo IV Quarterly Update — March 2022 (art direction)

sources.title: Fleur's Fabel — Art bible (Beeyou)
load_bearing: Section order: Art style (General/2D/3D env/Shaders-VFX), Reference-Moodboards, Character art, Character design workflow, 3D production workflow, Camera, Level of details, Atmosphere, Color Palette (per area + characters), User Interface
'Only character using blue in color scheme to create contrast with forest residents' — exclusion rule with reason, scoped to one entity
'Character colors are generally a bit brighter and lighter than the environment to make the characters stand out' — figure/ground relation rule
'Flower on hat changes color with emotion' — placement rule with state dependency
'Flat colors & cel shading, dark outline'; 'Simple, clear shapes'
Literal swatch strips per character and per environment area
Named 'Level of details' section governing where detail is permitted

load_bearing: Strong silhouettes; class readability (melee/caster/thief); archetypal characterization with small twists
Three-layer composition: background dimmed, midground high-contrast character lighting, foreground UI
Armor progression 'start barebones but recognizable and end up incredibly ornate'

sources.title: MaSC: A Masked Similarity Metric for Evaluating Concept-Driven Generation
load_bearing: Global cosine averages over the whole image including background variation humans ignore
Requires externally provided foreground concept mask; SAM3 prompted by canonical concept name on DreamBench++
Krippendorff alpha=+0.471 on CP, 72% of human inter-rater ceiling; AUC=0.992 on ORIDa; first non-LLM metric to outscore GPT-4o
Limitation: depends on externally supplied masks; fails when segmentation fails or subjects small/absent/ambiguous

sources.title: TIFA: Accurate and Interpretable Text-to-Image Faithfulness Evaluation with Question Answering (ICCV 2023)
load_bearing: Auto-generate QA pairs with an LM; check whether VQA models can answer them on the generated image; reference-free
TIFA v1.0: 4K text inputs, 25K questions, 12 categories
Spearman rho 0.60 / Kendall tau 0.47 for TIFA(mPLUG) — SECONDARY (search summary, not abstract)

sources.title: Davidsonian Scene Graph (DSG), ICLR 2024
load_bearing: Atomic and unique questions in dependency graphs to sidestep inconsistent answers
Questions must respect the prompt (no hallucination/duplication/omission); VQA answers must be consistent
DSG-1k: 1,060 prompts

sources.title: Safety compliance checking of construction behaviors using visual question answering
load_bearing: Converts safety rules into questions; VQA infers answers; pass/fail gate. Domain-transfer precedent for bible-as-rules.

sources.title: Spatial Reasoning in Foundation Models: Benchmarking Object-Centric Spatial Understanding
load_bearing: Task-specific vision models outperform general VLMs by a clear margin on spatial localization

sources.title: The Unwinnable Arms Race of AI Image Detection
load_bearing: Detectors key on generator-specific compression/encoding artifacts, not semantics
Poor cross-generator generalization; vulnerable to resize, JPEG, inpainting/repaint
CONTRAINDICATION: do not use an AI-detector as an acceptance gate

load_bearing: ~10ms per image on a single GPU (8ms encoder + 4ms decoder); 4x faster than FastSAM (40ms)

sources.title: OpenCV structural analysis & shape descriptors; LearnOpenCV Hu-moments guidance
load_bearing: Hu invariance 'is proved with the assumption of infinite image resolution'
'In case of raster images, the computed Hu invariants for the original and transformed images are a bit different'
'There is no universal matchShapes cutoff' — calibrate same-class vs different-class on your own production imagery

sources.title: ID maps / clown mapping in game texturing (Substance 3D Painter practice)
load_bearing: ID map = a baked texture where each material region is filled with a flat solid colour; green->leather, blue->metal, red->fabric
Keep each colour maximally distinct so anti-aliasing at borders doesn't create an ambiguous intermediate colour that confuses the mask generator
Precedent for PARTS[].palette_bin and for the designed-for-the-oracle costume approach

sources.title: DreamBooth evaluation protocol (CLIP-I / DINO / CLIP-T)
load_bearing: CLIP-I = pairwise cosine of CLIP ViT-B/32 image embeddings; DINO = pairwise cosine of ViT-S/16 DINO embeddings
DINO preferred for subject fidelity: sensitive to differences between subjects of the same class
